highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.0 previews Skia m155 and HarfBuzz 14.4.0 with intentional text-shaping changes.
highlights_body: HarfBuzz updates cross-direction mark positioning and glyph-position saturation. This line also retires built-in RAW/DNG decoding and corrects GPU cache cleanup and fontconfig candidate matching.

breaking.title: Decode RAW and DNG outside SkiaSharp
breaking.body: Built-in RAW/DNG decoding and PIEX extraction of JPEG previews from RAW containers are disabled; no replacement reader is included. Decode or convert these files with another library before using SkiaSharp. SKEncodedImageFormat.Dng retains value 10 for compatibility but no longer indicates codec support. Standalone JPEG decoding is unchanged.

bullets.detail: Advances the engine to milestone m155 while preserving existing rotation-scale text-run bounds behavior.

Updates shaping with cross-direction mark positioning changes for DirectWrite/Core Text compatibility, glyph-position saturation, malformed-font crash and hang fixes, and shaping/subsetting performance work.
Adds documented OpenTypeBitsTag and OpenTypeNumberTag enums. Raw OpenType fetch functions remain internal; no Face wrappers are introduced.
Drops uniquely held Ganesh cache entries after failed flushes so later draws cannot reuse those evicted entries for uninitialized textures.
Fontconfig checks family acceptability on the first valid sorted candidate rather than accepting a lower-ranked substitute prematurely.

preview_summaries.v4.155.0-preview.1.26471.14: Preview 1 introduced Skia m155 while retaining existing managed APIs and rotation-scale text-run bounds behavior.
preview_summaries.v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13: Preview 2 updated native HarfBuzz to 14.4.0 and added the OpenType value-tag enums. It also retired RAW/DNG decoding and embedded JPEG preview extraction.
preview_summaries.v4.155.0-rc.1.26512.8: Release Candidate 1 corrected Ganesh cache cleanup after failed flushes and fontconfig first-candidate matching.

harfbuzz_summary: Updates native HarfBuzz from 14.2.1 to 14.4.0, changing cross-direction mark positioning and glyph-position saturation while fixing malformed-font crashes and hangs. Adds OpenTypeBitsTag and OpenTypeNumberTag enums; raw fetch functions remain internal without new Face wrappers.

v4.155.0-preview.1.26471.14.headline: SkiaSharp 4.155.0 Preview 1 introduces the Skia m155 engine.

v4.155.0-preview.2.26479.13.headline: Preview 2 updates HarfBuzz to 14.4.0 and retires built-in RAW and DNG decoding.

v4.155.0-rc.1.26512.8.headline: Release Candidate 1 corrects failed-flush cache cleanup and Linux font-candidate matching.
